name: matches
description: Ranked matches ingested in the patch

name: boards
description: Participants in those matches (8 per match)

name: last_played_at
description: Newest match in the patch; the latest patch is the one with the newest value

name: placement_sum
description: Sum of all the patch's boards' placements (1-8); NULL on rows written before this column existed, until jobs.rebuild_stats --table patch_totals
